repo.description: Watched repository as owner/name — REQUIRED per deployment. Drives the webhook repo filter and the ci-signal repo check.

webhook_secret_env.description: Env var holding this repo's webhook HMAC secret — the BUPHA_WH_<OWNER>_<REPO> convention (uppercased, '-' → '_'). REQUIRED per deployment; the var must exist in the campaign service env (~/.config/peregrin/env or cuora).

checkout.description: Local clone path lasius operates on — REQUIRED per deployment.

worktree_base.description: Detached review worktrees, the per-PR attempt ledger, and the per-sha PR map land here.

agent.description: sepia agent-config id for review sessions.

agent_mode.description: ACP session mode applied after create (session/set_mode). REQUIRED for unattended runs — devin's default accept-edits prompts on exec and deadlocks. 'bypass' auto-approves all tools; 'smart' auto-runs model-judged-safe actions; 'accept-edits' only auto-approves edits.

max_review_attempts.description: Per-PR cap on agent review attempts — counted in <worktree_base>/attempts/pr-<n>-reviews, durable across restarts.

verify_cmd.description: Verification command embedded in the agent prompt — the agent runs it inside the worktree; the campaign does not execute it.

merge_method.description: Merge method passed to `lasius forge pr merge` (--method).

lasius_root.description: lasius workspace root (--root flag); repo args are checkout paths so any lasius.toml workspace works.

trusted_actors.description: Comma-separated GitHub logins allowed to reach the agent and auto-merge — checked against the PR AUTHOR in the review guard and merge node. Empty = deny all (fail closed).
